Extra-Time Frenzy and Red Card The added 30 minutes began with a flurry of goals. Gaetan Weissbeck briefly pulled Apollon Limassol level again in the 92nd minute, but Brann responded almost immediately. Noah Holm secured his second of the night in the 95th minute thanks to Kristian Eriksen , before Eriksen himself turned scorer in the 105th minute to make it 2-4, set up once again by the influential Vetle Dragsnes . There was one final twist in the 118th minute when Kristall Mani Ingason was shown a second yellow card and sent off, leaving Brann to defend their lead with ten men. Despite the late dismissal, the visitors held firm to secure a remarkable victory in a contest that will be remembered for its relentless intensity.
